verdict: design falsified: a tree that makes no correction reaches total=0 C1_R55_PASS=true under the frozen counter bytes and under the wave-1 amendment

findings.title: absence of a record file reads as compliance
findings.detail: scan() does `if body is None: continue` (frozen measure.py:82-96), so git rm corpus/QUALITY.md corpus/lessons/round-54.md removes every stale hit in them. The E1B tree deletes 1721 lines of record and still scores total=0 on both byte sets.

findings.title: the corrections exemption is positional, not grammatical
findings.detail: corrections() returns the text between the heading and the next `## ` heading (measure.py:66-80) and scan() subtracts that text before matching. Inserting the heading above the round-54 block puts every stale line inside the exempt block without editing one byte. The block also runs to EOF when it is the last section, so the exemption grows.

findings.title: the corrected arm is token presence, so it cannot tell a correction from a copy
findings.detail: Every class's corrected arm is `token in corr`; the counter prints those tokens in --explain. A section that states it makes no correction and pastes them scores 10/10 (E1B). No receipt-pointer or old->new grammar is checked.

findings.title: R54.4 never hashes the bytes it certifies; the manifest is editable
findings.detail: derive_freeze_digest() reads .ufo/evidence/round-54/freeze.json and the counter never computes sha256 of c2/measure.py at rev. Rewriting the manifest yields R54.4 ok with a digest the tree does not have (E5B: certifies deadbeef, actual 8528ee85).

findings.title: the stale scan is defeated by typography (survives amendment 5)
findings.detail: `positive control` -> `positive-control` and `84 staged` -> `84  staged` leave every false claim readable and score stale=0 on both byte sets. Amendment 5's whitespace-collapsed span scan catches only the one line whose words are split across a wrap.

findings.title: stale scope is per class and misses records that state the claim
findings.detail: RECORD omits LOG.md in the frozen bytes (LOG.md:2500 carried R54.2's false 'freeze pointer the deciding run uses' for 7883e0e5). Amendment 5 adds LOG.md to RECORD but R54.2/R54.3/R54.9 pass their own single-file tuples (measure.py:206,214,256), so R54.2 still reports stale=0 on the amended counter with LOG.md unchanged. SKILL.md is unscanned. The spotcheck lesson is correctly excluded.

findings.title: the verdict depends on a live external project (non-hermetic)
findings.detail: STAGED_DEFAULT=/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokuknow (measure.py:39) is globbed at measure time (measure.py:142). The same passing revision scores PASS with it present and total>=1 with it absent, so R54.9's `staged=81` is not a property of the revision.

findings.title: the verdict does not assert its denominator
findings.detail: total is computed over whatever rows exist (measure.py:278-284); a copy with row("R54.6", ...) removed prints classes=9 total=0 PASS=true and exits 0. A lost class is never reported as could-not-evaluate.

findings.title: a crash is scored as a failed class, not as could-not-evaluate
findings.detail: Only Setup is caught (measure.py:291-294). A malformed round-54 freeze.json dies with AttributeError at measure.py:126 and exits 1 with no verdict line, the same code as an honest miss.

findings.title: numeral premises are satisfied by pre-existing or self-authored text
findings.detail: R54.8's 'seat marked superseded' is satisfied at base by an unrelated round-50 clause (T54W1ExecStraceNoise.md:299); R54.10's r53-counter-at-88afa941 is hard-coded in the counter, not derived; R54.5's counts are derived from any file matching T54W\d+[A-Za-z]*Read\d+\.json, so adding T54W1Read99.json moves the required value to w1=30 and R54.5 passes.

findings.title: frozen counter edited mid-wave with an inconsistent manifest
findings.detail: Working c1/measure.py is 711507e7 (mtime 14:00:09) while working freeze.json pins 77abe1e9 and lists 3 amendments against contract.json's 5. controls.sh extracts from the freeze commit, so controls would score 77abe1e9 while the amendment intends 711507e7. Reported, not fixed; both byte sets were scored and pinned by digest.

smallest_safe_correction: scan()/scan_span(): a missing record file fails the class; require every RECORD path exists at rev
replace the positional exemption with a per-line correction grammar (R54.N old: X -> new: Y (receipt: PATH)); exempt only matching lines and require the heading exactly once

bind values to the tree: R54.4 sha256(c2/measure.py at rev) equals the quoted digest and the manifest entry; R54.2 forbids any non-receipt 8-hex pointer; R54.5 counts only registry-named readers; R54.10 derives 88afa941 from the receipt filename
every class's stale scan uses RECORD (drop the per-class tuples at 195/206/214/256)
assert len(rows)==10 and the id set, else exit 2
catch Exception -> C1_SETUP could-not-evaluate exit 2, keep 1 for a failed class
delete STAGED_DEFAULT as a live path; take the staged count from a lane-committed artefact or freeze staged=81 in the contract
R54.8 seat arm matches a line naming R54.8, not any occurrence of 'superseded'

CTL_SKIP replay (tokens at EOF, no stale work) is refused: total=4
spotcheck lesson correctly excluded from RECORD
all four base stale hits are genuine false assertions (no base false positive)
